name: Rumble-2-Flash
purpose: Small multilingual speech recognition model (45 languages) with Transformers and vLLM support and transcription switches for digits, fillers and verbatim mode (card). The card states no further motivation.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file in the HF repo read: Apache License 2.0 text.

architecture.kind: audio encoder (18 layers, d_model 896) plus Qwen3-style decoder (hidden 1024), CTC head file in repo

variants.notes: model 1.02 GB plus ctc head 0.36 GB

engine_support.notes: Third-party GGUF repos (kaptionai, cstr) exist; support in a given runtime not tested.

benchmarks.name: Open ASR Leaderboard English average WER (7 public splits plus private)
benchmarks.harness: Open ASR Leaderboard v1.16.1, release 2026-11-18; RTFx 6338

benchmarks.name: Open ASR Leaderboard German average WER (FLEURS 4.77, Common Voice 6.28)
benchmarks.harness: Open ASR Leaderboard v1.16.1 multilingual track

benchmarks.name: Open ASR Leaderboard Spanish average WER
Open ASR Leaderboard French average WER

strengths: 0.5B parameters with German 5.52% average WER on the Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track
Switches for digits, fillers, verbatim output
weaknesses: The leaderboard numbers were produced and reported by the builder; no independent run seen
German leaderboard average here is higher than parakeet-ultra FLEURS German (3.61%), but datasets differ (leaderboard averages FLEURS and Common Voice)
best_for: small multilingual ASR where a Qwen3-ASR-based stack is already available
soft.maturity: Reson8; 929 downloads and 151 likes on HF API 2026-11-19, first release 2026-10-14.

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0, 1.4 GB, German supported with 5.5% on the leaderboard mix; shares the Qwen3-ASR architecture of qwen3-asr-1.7b (record exists), so work on that carries over. Needs a head-to-head on German with parakeet-ultra, Qwen3-ASR 1.7B and whisper-large-v3-turbo-german before any offer.

sources.note: referenced by the card, leaderboard page itself not opened

open_questions: Training data and recipe (card gives none)
Relation between Rumble-2-Flash and larger Rumble models
